faqs.question: How long does training typically take?
faqs.questionPt: Quanto tempo leva o treinamento normalmente?
faqs.answer: Training programs range from 4 to 8 weeks depending on the curriculum. We can customize the duration to fit your schedule.

faqs.question: Can we do training on-site?
faqs.questionPt: Podemos fazer treinamento nas dependências da empresa?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer on-site, remote, and hybrid training options. We'll work with your logistics team to arrange the best setup.

faqs.question: What if our team has mixed skill levels?
faqs.questionPt: E se nossa equipe tiver níveis diferentes de habilidade?
faqs.answer: We assess each participant's level and customize the curriculum accordingly. We ensure everyone progresses at an appropriate pace.

faqs.question: Do you provide training materials?
faqs.answer: Yes! We provide comprehensive training materials, code examples, documentation, and access to resource libraries.

faqs.question: Can we get a custom program for our specific needs?
faqs.questionPt: Podemos obter um programa personalizado para nossas necessidades específicas?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We specialize in custom programs. We'll work with you to design training that addresses your company's specific challenges.

faqs.question: What's the typical team size for training?
faqs.questionPt: Qual é o tamanho típico da equipe para treinamento?
faqs.answer: We can train teams of any size, from small groups (5-10 people) to large teams (100+). Pricing varies based on team size.
